claims: Monitor blood glucose closely and treat hyperglycemia, as fingerstick glucose was 187 mg/dL and serum glucose 175 mg/dL with active insulin and glucose gel orders.
Continue supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula at 2 L/min and monitor SpO2 to maintain saturation above 88%.
Replete magnesium given serum magnesium 1.5 mg/dL.
Replete calcium given total calcium 7.2 mg/dL.
Replete phosphorus given serum phosphate 2.2 mg/dL.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit given anemia with hemoglobin 9.6 g/dL and hematocrit 28.6%, and a prior lower hemoglobin of 8.1 g/dL.
Monitor for infection or inflammation given leukocytosis with WBC 13.6 K/uL and neutrophilia 86%.
Monitor renal function and electrolytes given BUN 28 mg/dL, creatinine 0.8 mg/dL, and chloride 112 mEq/L.
Perform urinalysis review and monitor for urinary tract infection given urine leukocytes SM, blood MOD, and ketones 15 mg/dL.
Continue cardiac monitoring with ST segment monitoring and serial troponin assessment given troponin-T 0.01 ng/mL and CK-MB 4 ng/mL.
